ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_weighted_margin_entropy_advantage_normalized
ir.intuition: Normalize the combined weighting by the sum of weights to ensure scale-invariant normalization, maintaining balance in the presence of varying batch weights and modulated by entropy and advantage signals.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = clamp((log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * (advantage_w - advantage_l), -20, 20)
entropy_diff = max(entropy_l - entropy_w, 0)
weight_mod = sigmoid(entropy_diff) * weight
loss_raw = -logsigmoid(margin) * weight_mod
loss = sum(loss_raw) / (sum(weight_mod) + 1e-8)
return loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    ent_w = batch.get('entropy_w', ops.zeros_like(lpw))
    ent_l = batch.get('entropy_l', ops.zeros_like(lpl))

    margin_raw = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l))
    margin = ops.clamp(margin_raw, -20.0, 20.0)

    entropy_diff = ops.max(ops.sub(ent_l, ent_w), ops.zeros_like(ent_l))
    weight_mod = ops.mul(ops.sigmoid(entropy_diff), weight)

    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(margin)), weight_mod)
    normalizer = ops.add(ops.sum(weight_mod), 1e-8)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_raw), normalizer)

    return loss
